verdict.rationale: Mastra Code exposes programmatic surfaces (runMC, exported classes, a reference API), so API versioning and deprecation policy is a fair question. However, the evidence pack contains no documented API versioning scheme or deprecation policy. The `mastracode update` command only installs the latest release and is not an API versioning or deprecation guarantee.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
